notes: Patience is commonly framed as a general virtue.
Nurturing matches care; poisonous suggests harm/contamination.
Soulful/soulless invokes spirituality; soulless can imply broad moral emptiness.
Idealist can invoke ideals or values.
Nihilist can imply rejection of moral values.
Objective relates to impartiality or unbiased judgment.
Theist/atheist concerns religious or spiritual belief.
Classical versus avant-garde maps to tradition versus nonconformity.
Communal matches group loyalty; individualist can invoke autonomy.
Equitable matches fairness; hypocritical is a general moral vice.
Relates to self-discipline versus laxness; slacker is a general vice term.
Helplessness signals vulnerability and need for care.
